mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1% (as of t-1mo) and the signal is active.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE increases by >0.3pp monthly, SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS shows no negative correlation with SPX 60-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated CPI index levels above 260 signal persistent inflation that forces monetary tightening, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL exceeds 260, SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS rises month-over-month and the signal is active.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.5 signals manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO falls below 100.5, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over the last 5 years.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad economic slowdown that triggers equity market weakness, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline of GDPC1 and HOUST shows no negative correlation with SPX 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary policy tightening (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%) increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days during tightening cycles.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0%, SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of cases over the last 5 years.
